elements.requirement: The appropriate regulator may impose on an authorised person a penalty of such amount as that regulator considers appropriate in respect of a contravention, if the regulator considers that the authorised person has contravened a relevant requirement imposed on that authorised person.
elements.quote: If the appropriate regulator considers that an authorised person has contravened a relevant requirement imposed on the person, it may impose on him a penalty, in respect of the contravention, of such amount as it considers appropriate.

elements.requirement: The FCA may impose on a person other than an authorised person a penalty of such amount as the FCA considers appropriate in respect of a contravention, if the FCA considers that the person has contravened a relevant Part 5A requirement imposed on that person.
elements.quote: If the FCA considers that a person other than an authorised person has contravened a relevant Part 5A requirement imposed on the person, it may impose on the person a penalty, in respect of the contravention, of such amount as it considers appropriate.

elements.requirement: A penalty imposed under section 206 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 is payable to the regulator that imposed the penalty.
elements.quote: A penalty under this section is payable to the regulator that imposed the penalty.
